title: Define product foundation
prompt: We are starting PawLedger, a local-first dog training app. Define the initial architecture and product lanes.
promote_summary: PawLedger is a local-first dog training workspace. Core lanes are Assess, Train, and Review. It prioritizes humane training, privacy, explainable plans, and repeatable progress tracking.

title: Create domain model
prompt: Add the first domain model for PawLedger. It should support dogs, handlers, training goals, and session records while preserving the foundation from the previous task.
promote_summary: Core entities are DogProfile, HandlerProfile, TrainingGoal, and SessionLog. These support PawLedger lanes and remain local-first.

title: Define local persistence
prompt: Design the local persistence layer for the domain model. Make sure it supports accepted entities and does not introduce cloud identity.
promote_summary: Persistence uses SQLite with UTC timestamps, migration_version, soft_delete, and deterministic IDs. It stores DogProfile, HandlerProfile, TrainingGoal, and SessionLog without cloud identity.

title: Set privacy and auth boundaries
prompt: Add privacy and access boundaries compatible with local persistence and product principles.
promote_summary: PawLedger uses a local passcode, no cloud accounts, and optional encrypted export while preserving local SQLite storage.

title: Build assessment rubric
prompt: Design the assessment model for the Assess lane. It should support behavior review and risk-aware planning while preserving privacy and storage decisions.
promote_summary: Assess uses BehaviorRubric with severity 1-5, triggers, reinforcers, and thresholds tied to DogProfile and TrainingGoal.

title: Generate training plans
prompt: Create training plan structure using assessment output. Carry forward the domain model, storage approach, and humane training rules.
promote_summary: Train creates TrainingPlan objects composed of Exercise, Criteria, SafetyNote, and a 7-day microcycle using positive reinforcement and BehaviorRubric details.

title: Add session execution states
prompt: Design how a user runs a training session from a plan. The state model must integrate with plans, logs, and review needs.
promote_summary: Training sessions use SessionState values queued, running, paused, completed, and abandoned. They link to TrainingPlan and SessionLog.

title: Track rewards and recovery
prompt: Add reward and recovery tracking to sessions. It must work with the accepted session state model and feed future review summaries.
promote_summary: Sessions track RewardLedger entries with reward type and reward latency. RewardRecoveryProfile captures reinforcer and recovery patterns for Review.

title: Create reminder policy
prompt: Design reminders that support plan adherence without violating privacy, humane, or local-first stance.
promote_summary: ReminderPolicy uses quiet hours, timezone-aware local notifications, and a no nagging rule to support TrainingPlan adherence without cloud push.

title: Build progress snapshots
prompt: Design weekly progress review using previous session, reward, and reminder decisions.
promote_summary: Review uses ProgressSnapshot to track weekly trends, adherence, and criteria success using SessionState, RewardLedger, RewardRecoveryProfile, and ReminderPolicy.

title: Support multiple dogs
prompt: Extend the design for households with multiple dogs and handlers. Avoid data mixing and preserve privacy and review decisions.
promote_summary: Multi-dog support uses Household, DogMembership, and HandlerRole. Prevent data mixing between DogProfile records.

title: Add safety boundaries
prompt: Add safety boundaries to plans and reviews. Respect humane training and avoid diagnosing medical issues.
promote_summary: Safety boundaries include VetReferral, never diagnose, unsafe_to_continue, and professional trainer guidance. SafetyNote appears when thresholds or severity indicate risk.

title: Generate training content
prompt: Design content generation for training plans and progress summaries without drifting from accepted rules.
promote_summary: Make outputs include TrainingCard, SessionSummary, ProgressSummary, long-form plans, and short-form cards while preserving SafetyNote, positive reinforcement, and never diagnose boundaries.

title: Add portable import export
prompt: Add import/export design preserving accumulated data, privacy choices, and schema evolution.
promote_summary: Import/export uses portable JSONL with schema version and ImportExportManifest, preserving migration_version, soft_delete, encrypted export, Household, DogProfile, and progress history.

title: Define mobile UX routes
prompt: Define the main UX routes for the full app aligned with lanes, memory, and domain model.
promote_summary: Mobile-first UX routes are Dogs tab, Plan tab, Session tab, Progress tab, and Library tab. They map to Assess, Train, Review, and Make outputs.

title: Handle complex edge cases
prompt: Add support for rescue dogs, multiple handlers, and reactive thresholds using established safety, assessment, and household decisions.
promote_summary: Complex cases include rescue dog profile, multiple handlers, reactive threshold, and cooldown period. These respect Household, HandlerRole, BehaviorRubric, VetReferral, and unsafe_to_continue.

title: Create testing strategy
prompt: Create a test strategy covering the full evolving system, not just the current module.
promote_summary: Testing uses scenario fixtures and deterministic seeds. It covers state transitions, privacy tests, import/export tests, safety boundary tests, multi-dog household behavior, and progress review.

title: Define foraging source policy
prompt: Define a research source policy supporting fresh external knowledge while protecting against low-quality or unsafe advice.
promote_summary: ForageSourcePolicy prefers trusted sources with source freshness and a citation trail. It rejects dominance theory and unsafe punishment advice.

title: Optimize context layering
prompt: Design context layering for global memory, scoped memory, retrieved evidence, and task-local context.
promote_summary: Context layering separates global memory, scoped memory, retrieved evidence, and task-local context. Promotion and pruning rules decide durable knowledge versus task noise.

title: Produce final build plan
prompt: Create the final implementation roadmap using the full accumulated architecture without contradicting earlier decisions.
promote_summary: Final build plan should sequence PawLedger implementation across persistence, domain model, Assess, Train, Review, Make, import/export, safety boundaries, source policy, tests, and UX routes.

title: Refactor architecture safely
prompt: Refactor the architecture to improve modularity without breaking established Assess, Train, Review, and Make lanes.
promote_summary: Architecture refactor introduces modular service boundaries with lane contract tests and backward-compatible interfaces, preserving existing lane behavior and safety rules.

title: Add cross-lane feature
prompt: Add a feature that touches Assess, Train, and Review while preserving existing data, safety, and memory rules.
promote_summary: CrossLaneInsight links Assess, Train, and Review through shared goal state and synchronized lane updates without violating prior architecture constraints.

title: Preserve schema with migration
prompt: Introduce a migration that extends storage while preserving old schema decisions, compatibility, and rollback safety.
promote_summary: Migration strategy preserves legacy schema compatibility via backfill script, invariant checks, and a rollback plan aligned with prior migration and privacy policies.

title: Harden offline export/import edge cases
prompt: Add offline export and import edge-case handling for partial writes, retries, and conflict reconciliation.
promote_summary: Offline import/export now covers partial import recovery, idempotent replay, and deterministic conflict resolution while keeping encrypted local export guarantees.

title: Handle safety-sensitive domain incident
prompt: Design handling for a safety-sensitive canine behavior case with strict escalation boundaries and humane guidance.
promote_summary: Safety-sensitive handling adds explicit escalation protocol, high-risk interruption flow, and veterinary escalation triggers while preserving humane non-diagnostic boundaries.

title: Write full-system technical docs
prompt: Write technical documentation that accurately reflects the current whole system, decisions, and operational boundaries.
promote_summary: Documentation package now includes ADR-style architecture records, operator runbook, and model boundary notes with traceable links to prior decisions.

title: Expand cross-module test coverage
prompt: Add test coverage that spans persistence, lane workflows, migration paths, safety boundaries, and regression hotspots.
promote_summary: Testing expansion adds cross-module integration coverage, migration matrix checks, and regression guardrails mapped to prior feature and safety decisions.

title: Debug regression from conflicting decisions
prompt: Debug a regression introduced by conflicting earlier decisions and define a repeatable conflict-resolution process.
promote_summary: Regression debugging now follows triage protocol, conflict resolver rules, and a root-cause log tied to decision drift audits and regression tests.

title: Create release checklist and limitations
prompt: Create a release checklist with known limitations, risk tracking, and go/no-go criteria rooted in prior architecture decisions.
promote_summary: Release readiness now includes explicit checklist, known limitations register, and go/no-go criteria with risk logging across safety and privacy boundaries.

title: Produce implementation handoff roadmap
prompt: Produce a final implementation handoff and build roadmap covering phased delivery, acceptance gates, and post-release validation.
promote_summary: Final handoff roadmap defines phased milestones, acceptance criteria, and post-release validation while preserving full-system continuity and safety constraints.
